purpose: Derive Research OS V1 baseline/challenger benchmark metrics from structured telemetry and bind both sides to the exact frozen cohort without self-reported aggregate metrics or case relabeling.
identity_source: cohort_case_metadata from the automatically frozen prospective cohort
exact_pairing_rules: Both sides must contain every frozen cohort case exactly once.
No extra or missing case is permitted.
case_id, active_hour_id, candidate_id, task_shape, representative_task_id and legacy_role must exactly match the frozen cohort metadata.
A side cannot provide or alter authoritative ground_truth_class; resolver ground truth is injected after telemetry validation.
Both side artifacts must carry the exact frozen cohort_hash.

metric_derivation_rules.unique_relevant_evidence: count of distinct evidence_id entries marked relevant=true
metric_derivation_rules.contradictions_found: count of evidence entries with contradiction=true
metric_derivation_rules.point_in_time_and_provenance_complete: true only when every relevant evidence entry has point_in_time_ok=true and provenance_ok=true
metric_derivation_rules.source_families_covered: set of source_family values among relevant evidence
metric_derivation_rules.duplicate_research_items: count of research_items carrying a non-null duplicate_of
metric_derivation_rules.applicable_known_failure_patterns: count of failure-pattern entries marked applicable=true
metric_derivation_rules.failure_patterns_before_expensive_work: count of applicable failure-pattern entries marked detected_before_expensive_work=true
metric_derivation_rules.hard_failures: exact unique hard-failure IDs supplied by structured telemetry
metric_derivation_rules.steps_to_decisive_falsification: required non-negative integer for every DECISIVE_NEGATIVE case
metric_derivation_rules.coordination_overhead_units: optional non-negative measured units; never imputed
metric_derivation_rules.plan_usage_units: optional non-negative measured units; never imputed

anti_gaming_rules: Self-reported aggregate metric fields in raw telemetry are ignored.
Duplicate evidence IDs, research item IDs, worker run IDs, failure-pattern IDs and starvation event IDs fail closed.
A failure pattern cannot be counted as detected-before-expensive-work unless it is also applicable.
Missing telemetry for one frozen case blocks the benchmark rather than being treated as zero.
Missing optional metrics remain missing; they are never coerced to zero.
Baseline and challenger summaries are compared only after exact cohort identity validation.
